title: Privacy Policy – Mavi Pool
intro: The purpose of this privacy policy is to inform users of the Mavi Pool website about how their personal data may be collected and processed.

dataCollected.title: Data Collected
dataCollected.p1: The Mavi Pool website does not offer a contact form and does not voluntarily collect personal data.
dataCollected.p2: However, certain data may be collected automatically during navigation:
list: Technical browsing data (browser, device, pages viewed)
dataCollected.p3: This data is collected indirectly by:
list2: Services necessary for the proper functioning of the site

dataUse.title: Use of Data
dataUse.p1: Data collected automatically is used strictly to:
list: Ensure the proper functioning and security of the site
dataUse.p2: No data is used for commercial or advertising purposes.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services Used
thirdParty.p1: The Mavi Pool website uses external services that may result in data transfer:
list: Google Fonts: used for displaying fonts → May result in a request to Google's servers
Google Search Console: used solely to analyze site visibility in search results (no direct collection of personal data by the site)

Google Tag Manager / Google Analytics: used, subject to your consent, to measure site traffic (pages viewed, traffic sources) → Audience measurement cookies are only set after you accept via the consent banner

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: The Mavi Pool website uses audience measurement cookies (Google Analytics via Google Tag Manager), which are only set after you have given your consent via the dedicated banner.
cookies.p2: You can accept, decline, or change your choice at any time via the "Manage cookies" link available in the footer.
cookies.p3: Some other third-party services may also use technical cookies necessary for their functioning.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.p1: The site is hosted by: Vercel Inc. 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, United States
hosting.p2: The host may collect technical data (logs, IP addresses) for security and maintenance purposes.

retention.title: Retention Period
retention.p1: Technical data collected automatically is kept for a limited time, strictly necessary for the proper functioning and security of the site.

userRights.title: User Rights
userRights.p1: In accordance with applicable regulations, you have the following rights:
userRights.p2: For any requests, you can contact: mavipool@outlook.fr

contact.title: Contact
contact.p1: For any questions regarding this privacy policy: mavipool@outlook.fr
